zero_fix_verification.note: all_query_zero: no taste gates / com_cap (resolved_com_cap=None). Ranking uses equal weight over all percentile users (~n_percentile_users); mint gate count above is only the mint table size for comparison. Raising depth/purity/deweight switches to mint_deep scoring.

notes: max_n=0 means no ceiling (keep). Nonzero max_n caps Kish n_eff / votes.
Sliders at 0 → equal weight over all percentile users (not mint-only).
curator_deweight preferred over gate/equal-elite; core grid uses deweight=25 (expo=1).
Early SF/catalog work filter keeps all-zero rankings ~1s.
Keep max_n in simplified rebuild as a first-class control.
